title: Wall Street ends higher as traders return to AI stocks
article_content: Wall Street rose on Monday as investors rotated into AI-related equities, with tech names leading the gains. The rally was driven by enthusiasm around artificial intelligence deployment and its impact on earnings prospects, with AI-related stocks contributing to a broader tech-led rebound and market optimism.

title: Chinese banks boost loans to tech sector as Beijing ramps up AI push
article_content: Chinese lenders are increasing lending to technology firms and AI-related ventures in response to Beijing’s accelerated AI strategy. Bankers say policy support and financing incentives are encouraging banks to back domestic AI adoption, signaling a potential credit impulse for the tech sector.

title: Analysts revise AI hyperscaler debt forecasts after Amazon bond sale
article_content: Analysts raised expectations for AI hyperscaler debt issuance following Amazon's bond sale, with Bank of America increasing its 2026 debt forecast for hyperscalers to about $175 billion. The report underscores growing financing demand to support AI infrastructure and cloud-scale computing capacity.
